# thoth_mcp_catalog_verify (Resource)

Verifies the grants-derived MCP tool catalog for a principal/role and stores the check result.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_context_json` (String) Optional auth context JSON object merged into the verification request.
- `environment` (String) Optional environment filter (dev/prod).
- `human_groups` (List of String) Optional human groups for catalog verification context.
- `human_principal` (String) Optional human principal seed for catalog verification.
- `human_role` (String) Optional human role seed for catalog verification.
- `principal` (String) Principal used for catalog verification.
- `trigger` (String) Change this field to force another verification run.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_tools_count` (Number) Number of allowed tools in the result catalog.
- `blocked_tools_count` (Number) Number of blocked tools in the result catalog.
- `id` (String) Synthetic verification ID.
- `policy_count` (Number) Matched policy count returned by the verifier.
- `response_json` (String) Catalog verification response payload as JSON.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID from provider configuration.
- `verified_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when verification ran.
